about: 说话检查（不是记忆评测）：记忆已经摆在她面前时她怎么说。全部是合成用例，不含真实聊天。kind: holds＝没有变化信号时旧事实照旧算数；link＝眼前的话碰到对方说过的私人往事要接住；changed＝后来的事实说它变了，要按后来的说；quiet＝眼前的话和那些往事无关，不该硬提。

facts: [05-12] 家里养了一只玄凤鹦鹉，叫豆豆
[06-03] 给豆豆的笼子挂了遮光布，晚上睡得安稳多了
[07-20] 在一家设计公司上班
cases.message: 我下周要出差五天，家里有什么得提前安排的吗？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by 豆豆 the cockatiel still being at home and needing care while they are away (or asks lightly while still planning for it). Fail if it says it does not know or has no record of whether they still have the bird, or leaves the bird out.

facts: [04-20] 在一家物流公司做调度
[07-15] 每天下班前照常对一遍自己当天的单子
[05-02] 喜欢喝冰美式
cases.message: 最近老是下班特别晚，你说问题可能出在哪？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by their dispatcher job at the logistics company and their end-of-day checking as how things are now. Fail if it says it does not know whether they still do that job or has no record after some date.

facts: [06-10] 每天晚上跳绳二十分钟
[07-02] 跳绳跳得小腿有点淤青
[06-15] 周末常去图书馆
cases.message: 你觉得我现在这个运动量够吗？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply judges by their nightly twenty minutes of jumping rope as still going on (or asks lightly 'still jumping rope?' while going by it). Fail if it says it does not know whether they still do it or that it has no recent record.

facts: [05-08] 每天晚上练一小时吉他
[06-20] 给吉他换了一套新弦
cases.message: 我左手指尖的茧又厚了一层，你猜是怎么回事？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply puts it down to their nightly guitar practice. Fail if it says it does not know whether they still play, or guesses without the guitar.

facts: [05-30] 用手机记账，每一笔都记
[09-18] 前几天漏记的几笔今天补上了
[06-11] 养了两盆绿萝
cases.message: 月底了，我想看看这个月钱都花哪了，从哪下手比较好？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply points them to their own phone bookkeeping records as something they keep. Fail if it says it does not know whether they still keep accounts, or ignores that they do.

facts: [06-01] 借给发小小北五千块，说好年底还
[08-12] 和小北吃了顿饭，他没提钱的事
[07-04] 小北的生日在十一月
cases.message: 小北下周过生日，我该送点什么？心里还有点别的事有点纠结。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by the loan to 小北 still being open (gently touches on it, or asks lightly whether it has been paid back). Fail if it says it cannot know whether it was repaid and leaves it, or treats it as repaid.

facts: [04-11] 在一款网游里当公会会长
[07-30] 服务器回档那晚还在群里安抚会员
[05-05] 工作日晚上九点后才有空
cases.message: 这周末游戏里有个大型团战活动，我得忙些什么？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by them still leading the guild (organizing members, scheduling, rallying). Fail if it says it does not know whether they are still the guild leader.

facts: [08-01] 在追一部古装剧，每周四晚上更新两集
[09-10] 剧更新的两集看完很上头
[08-20] 不爱吃香菜
cases.message: 今晚终于等到更新的那天了，你猜我待会儿要干嘛？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply guesses the new episodes of the costume drama. Fail if it says it does not know whether they still follow it, or guesses without the drama.

facts: [05-15] 每天早上六点起床跑步
[06-01] 现在基本不熬夜了，十点前就睡
[05-20] 在读在职研究生
cases.message: 想报个网课，有早上七点和晚上九点半两个班，你觉得选哪个？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by their early routine (up at six, asleep before ten) and leans to the 7am class, or weighs it with that routine. Fail if it says it does not know their schedule, or recommends 9:30pm without regard to their sleeping before ten.

facts: [03-02] 去年爸爸住院那两个月，每天在医院陪床
[08-15] 换了工作，下个月去一家诊所做前台
[04-10] 喜欢周末骑车
cases.message: 明天第一天去诊所上班，有点紧张，一进门就是那股消毒水味。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply gently connects the disinfectant smell to the months at the hospital with their father, in a caring way. Fail if it only gives general first-day encouragement without that connection.

facts: [04-18] 小时候家里的狗旺财在一个雷雨夜走丢了，再也没找回来
[05-09] 现在一个人住
[06-01] 喜欢听播客
cases.message: 外面在打雷，雨下得好大。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply gently remembers 旺财 who was lost on a stormy night (or asks softly whether the thunder brings that back). Fail if it only talks about the weather, staying in, or curtains without that connection.

facts: [05-06] 刚来上海那年天天吃一家二十八块的豚骨拉面，那段日子很难
[07-12] 现在在上海做产品经理
[06-30] 养了一只柯基
cases.message: 今天路过一家豚骨拉面店，香味飘出来，我站在门口看了好久。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply gently connects it to their first hard year in Shanghai and the 28-yuan ramen. Fail if it only talks about the ramen itself (toppings, broth, whether to go in) without that connection.

facts: [06-22] 象棋是爷爷教的，爷爷走后一看到棋盘就难受
[07-01] 在一家银行上班
[06-05] 午休喜欢睡二十分钟
cases.message: 同事午休老拉我下象棋，我不太想去。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply gently connects their reluctance to their grandfather who taught them chess. Fail if it only gives advice on declining or office manners without that connection.

facts: [04-01] 每天骑车上班
[10-20] 打球把腿摔断了，医生说要养三个月
[05-11] 公司在城东
cases.message: 明天降温了，上班路上要注意什么？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by the broken leg (not cycling; taxi, subway, careful walking, crutches) or at least does not assume they cycle. Fail if it advises on cycling to work as usual.

facts: [03-10] 在一家奶茶店打工，周末全天班
[09-01] 奶茶店的工作辞了，现在在全职准备考研
[04-02] 爱看悬疑小说
cases.message: 周末你觉得我该怎么安排？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by them preparing for the graduate exam (not working weekend shifts at the tea shop). Fail if it plans around tea shop shifts.

facts: [05-02] 和女朋友小雨住在一起
[10-01] 和小雨分手了，搬回了父母家
[06-18] 会做红烧肉
cases.message: 这周末想下厨做顿饭，做几个人的量比较合适？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by them living with their parents now (cooking for the family) and does not assume 小雨. Fail if it suggests cooking for two with 小雨 or treats them as living with her.

facts: [02-14] 每天要喝两杯咖啡
[10-15] 医生说心律不齐，咖啡已经戒了
[03-03] 在写一本小说
cases.message: 下午好困，有什么提神的办法？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply does not suggest coffee (or notes they quit it) and offers other ways. Fail if it suggests a cup of coffee as usual.

facts: [04-05] 养了一只猫叫年糕
[09-20] 年糕走了，心里空空的
cases.message: 下班回家路上，想给家里带点什么，你有什么想法？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply does not suggest things for 年糕 (cat treats, toys) as if the cat were alive; gently acknowledging the loss is fine. Fail if it suggests buying something for 年糕.

facts: [01-10] 在北京工作
[08-30] 调到了深圳分公司，已经搬过去了
cases.message: 冬天快到了，要不要准备些厚衣服？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply goes by them living in Shenzhen now (mild winter, little need for heavy coats; ski trips aside). Fail if it advises for a Beijing winter as where they live.

facts: [03-01] 每周六早上和朋友去攀岩
[10-28] 怀孕了，刚三个月
[10-28] 怀孕了，攀岩这阵子大概要先停一停 (what you made of what they told you, not their words)
cases.message: 这周六早上空出来了，干点什么好？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply takes the pregnancy into account and does not simply suggest going climbing as usual (gentle activities, rest, or asking lightly is fine). Fail if it suggests the usual climbing without regard to the pregnancy.

facts: [02-20] 每天开车通勤
[10-25] 驾照被扣满了分，暂扣了
[10-25] 驾照暂扣了，这阵子大概开不了车，通勤得换别的方式 (what you made of what they told you, not their words)
cases.message: 明早下大雨，上班怎么走比较好？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply does not suggest driving (subway, bus, taxi, leaving early). Fail if it advises driving carefully in the rain as their way to work.

facts: [04-18] 小时候家里的狗旺财在一个雷雨夜走丢了，再也没找回来
[05-09] 在一家互联网公司带一个五人小组
cases.message: 帮我想个周会的开场白，轻松一点的。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply helps with a light meeting opener and does not bring up 旺财 or their loss. Fail if it brings up the lost dog.

facts: [03-02] 去年爸爸住院那两个月，每天在医院陪床
[06-12] 喜欢周星驰的电影
cases.message: 今晚想看部轻松的喜剧，推荐一部？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply recommends a comedy and does not bring up their father's hospital stay. Fail if it brings up the hospital months.

facts: [05-06] 刚来上海那年天天吃一家二十八块的豚骨拉面，那段日子很难
[07-12] 现在在上海做产品经理
cases.message: Excel 里怎么把两列合成一列？
cases.rule: Pass if the reply answers the Excel question and does not bring up the ramen or their first hard year. Fail if it brings those up.

facts: [06-22] 象棋是爷爷教的，爷爷走后一看到棋盘就难受
[07-01] 在一家银行上班
cases.message: 明天要交周报，帮我想几个标题。
cases.rule: Pass if the reply offers report titles and does not bring up their grandfather or chess. Fail if it brings those up.
